headline: BTC holds near $76.2k amid consolidation, altcoins rally on momentum
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC is holding above the 75,800‑76,000 support zone and testing the 76,800 resistance; the 4H structure shows higher lows, suggesting liquidity is being absorbed before a breakout.
altcoin_summary: Capital is rotating into high‑momentum altcoins, with SYN, ONE and LSK leading gains, indicating risk‑on sentiment beyond Bitcoin.
strategy_outlook: Enter spot BTC on a pull‑back to ~75,800 with a stop at 75,300; for futures, consider a short‑biased scalp above 76,800 targeting 75,900.
